from pyspark.sql.functions import * # collect_list, struct, explode, col,schema_of_json, from_json, to_json
import pyspark.sql.functions as F
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from pyspark.sql import Row
import pandas as pd
import json
from decimal import Decimal
anno_trimestre = "2025_2"
importTrimestrale = False

if importTrimestrale==False:
    mssparkutils.notebook.exit("no import trimestrale")

anno = anno_trimestre[:4]
trimestre = anno_trimestre[5:].rjust(2,'Q')
print(anno,trimestre)

# get the function to retrieve sql properties
%run Utility/getSQLConnectionString

# retrieve sql connection_string and connection_properties
jdbcUrl,conn_Prop = getSQLConnectionString()

query = f"""(SELECT 
			  recipient_id
			  ,CodiceArticolo
			  ,SUM([numero_tot]) as trx_Priv
			  ,SUM([valore_tot]) as val_Priv
		  FROM [ppa].[report_privati]
		where year_quarter = '{anno_trimestre}'
		group by recipient_id,CodiceArticolo) as tb"""
#dfMatriceRecapitisti = 
spark.read.jdbc(url=jdbcUrl, table=query, properties=conn_Prop).createOrReplaceTempView("tmpReportPrivati")
#display(dfMatriceRecapitisti)

#sconti
dfSconti = spark.sql(f"""
WITH sconti AS (
SELECT recipient_id
      ,year_quarter
      ,SUM(value_discount_sum) as sconto
      ,FlagMQ
	  ,CASE 
		WHEN FlagMQ = 1 THEN
			4
		ELSE
			PercSconto
	   END  as perSconto      
FROM pagopa.financial_report_sconti
WHERE 
year_quarter = '{anno_trimestre}'
GROUP BY recipient_id,year_quarter,FlagMQ,CASE 
		WHEN FlagMQ = 1 THEN
			4
		ELSE
			PercSconto
	   END)
SELECT 
		K.Numero as numero
		,K.Riferimento_data as dataFattura
		,'PROD-PAGOPA' as prodotto
		,K.Numero as identificativo
		,'SALDO PAGOPA' as tipologiaFattura
		,K.contract_id as istitutionId
		,K.contract_id as onboardingTokenID
		,K.Tipo_doc as tipoDocumento
		,'EUR' as divisa
		,K.Condizioni as metodoPagamento
		,'Piattaforma pagoPA - periodo {trimestre}-{anno}' as causale
		,'X' as split
		,'' as sollecito

		,'' as tipologia
		,'' as riferimentoNumeroLinea
		,'' as idDocumento
		,'' as data
		,'' as numItem
		,'' as codiceCommessaConvenzione
		,'' as CUP
		,'' as CIG

		,'' as testo
		,2 as numeroLinea
		,CASE 
            WHEN s.perSconto = 4 THEN
                'SCONTO'
            ELSE
                'SCONTO_MTA'
        END  as codiceMateriale
		,1 as quantita
		,s.sconto as PrezzoUnitario
		,'' as Imponibile
		,'' as PeriodoRiferimento
FROM sconti s
LEFT JOIN pagopa.kpmg_import k ON k.year_quarter = s.year_quarter
							AND k.contract_id = recipient_id
							AND k.Progressivo_Riga = 1

df = spark.sql(f"""
	SELECT 
			K.Numero as numero
			,K.Riferimento_data as dataFattura
			,'PROD-PAGOPA' as prodotto
			,K.Numero as identificativo
			,'SALDO PAGOPA' as tipologiaFattura
			,K.contract_id as istitutionId
			,K.contract_id as onboardingTokenID
			,K.Tipo_doc as tipoDocumento
			,'EUR' as divisa
			,K.Condizioni as metodoPagamento
			,'Piattaforma pagoPA - periodo {trimestre}-{anno}' as causale
			,'X' as split
			,'' as sollecito

			,'' as tipologia
			,'' as riferimentoNumeroLinea
			,'' as idDocumento
			,'' as data
			,'' as numItem
			,'' as codiceCommessaConvenzione
			,'' as CUP
			,'' as CIG

			,CASE 
				WHEN K.Progressivo_Riga = 1 THEN
					K.Descrizione_riga
				ELSE ''
			END as testo
			,K.Progressivo_riga as numeroLinea
			,CASE 
				WHEN K.Progressivo_Riga = 1 THEN
					'LINK'
				ELSE K.Codice_articolo
			END as codiceMateriale
			,K.Q_ta as quantita
			,K.Importo as PrezzoUnitario
			,'' as Imponibile
			,'' as PeriodoRiferimento
			

	FROM pagopa.kpmg_import K
	WHERE year_quarter = '{anno_trimestre}'
	ORDER BY contract_id,Progressivo_riga

df = spark.sql(f"""
	SELECT 
			K.Numero as numero
			,K.Riferimento_data as dataFattura
			,'PROD-PAGOPA' as prodotto
			,K.Numero as identificativo
			,'SALDO PAGOPA' as tipologiaFattura
			,K.contract_id as istitutionId
			,K.contract_id as onboardingTokenID
			,K.Tipo_doc as tipoDocumento
			,'EUR' as divisa
			,K.Condizioni as metodoPagamento
			,'Piattaforma pagoPA - periodo {trimestre}-{anno}' as causale
			,'X' as split
			,'' as sollecito

			,'' as tipologia
			,'' as riferimentoNumeroLinea
			,'' as idDocumento
			,'' as data
			,'' as numItem
			,'' as codiceCommessaConvenzione
			,'' as CUP
			,'' as CIG

			,CASE 
				WHEN K.Progressivo_Riga = 1 THEN
					K.Descrizione_riga
				ELSE ''
			END as testo
			,K.Progressivo_riga as numeroLinea
			,CASE 
				WHEN K.Progressivo_Riga = 1 THEN
					'LINK'
				ELSE K.Codice_articolo
			END as codiceMateriale
			--,K.Q_ta as quantita
			--,rp.trx_Priv as qPriv
			,K.q_ta - IF(rp.trx_Priv IS NULL,0 , rp.trx_Priv) as quantita
			--,K.Importo as PrezzoUnitario
			--,rp.val_Priv as valPriv
			,K.importo - IF(rp.val_Priv IS NULL, 0, rp.val_Priv) as PrezzoUnitario
			,'' as Imponibile
			,'PUB' as PeriodoRiferimento
			

	FROM pagopa.kpmg_import K
	LEFT JOIN tmpReportPrivati rp ON k.contract_id = rp.recipient_id
									AND k.codice_articolo = rp.CodiceArticolo
	WHERE k.year_quarter = '{anno_trimestre}'
	ORDER BY contract_id,Progressivo_riga

dfPriv = spark.sql(f"""
	SELECT 
			K.Numero as numero
			,K.Riferimento_data as dataFattura
			,'PROD-PAGOPA' as prodotto
			,K.Numero as identificativo
			,'SALDO PAGOPA' as tipologiaFattura
			,K.contract_id as istitutionId
			,K.contract_id as onboardingTokenID
			,K.Tipo_doc as tipoDocumento
			,'EUR' as divisa
			,K.Condizioni as metodoPagamento
			,'Piattaforma pagoPA - periodo {trimestre}-{anno}' as causale
			,'X' as split
			,'' as sollecito

			,'' as tipologia
			,'' as riferimentoNumeroLinea
			,'' as idDocumento
			,'' as data
			,'' as numItem
			,'' as codiceCommessaConvenzione
			,'' as CUP
			,'' as CIG

			,CASE 
				WHEN K.Progressivo_Riga = 1 THEN
					K.Descrizione_riga
				ELSE ''
			END as testo
			,K.Progressivo_riga as numeroLinea
			,rp.CodiceArticolo as codiceMateriale
			--,K.Q_ta as quantita
			--,rp.trx_Priv as qPriv
			,rp.trx_Priv as quantita
			--,K.Importo as PrezzoUnitario
			--,rp.val_Priv as valPriv
			,rp.val_Priv as PrezzoUnitario
			,'' as Imponibile
			,'PRI' as PeriodoRiferimento
	FROM tmpReportPrivati rp
	INNER JOIN pagopa.kpmg_import K ON k.contract_id = rp.recipient_id and k.codice_articolo = rp.CodiceArticolo
	WHERE k.year_quarter = '{anno_trimestre}'
dfUnion = df.union(dfSconti).union(dfPriv)

#df per ordinamento linee
OrdineData = [("LINK",1),
            ("SCONTO",99998),
            ("SCONTO_MTA",99998),
            ("BOLLO",99999)]
dfOrdine = spark.createDataFrame(OrdineData,["codiceMateriale", "order"])

dfUnion = dfUnion.join(dfOrdine, on="codiceMateriale",how="left")

dfUnion = dfUnion.withColumn("newOrder", when(col("order").isNull(), col("numeroLinea") + 2).otherwise(col("order")))
dfUnion = dfUnion.drop("order","numeroLinea")
#display(dfUnion)

dfUnion= dfUnion.withColumn("pu", when(col("newOrder") == 99998, round(col("PrezzoUnitario"),2)).otherwise(""))
dfUnion = dfUnion.drop("PrezzoUnitario")
dfUnion = dfUnion.withColumnRenamed("pu","PrezzoUnitario").filter(col("numero").isNotNull())

dfUnion = dfUnion.withColumn("daEliminare", when(\
                            ((col("codiceMateriale") == "SCONTO") | (col("codiceMateriale") == "SCONTO_MTA")) & (col("PrezzoUnitario") == 0.0), 1)\
                            .otherwise(0))

dfUnion = dfUnion.filter("daEliminare=0")

window_spec = Window.partitionBy("istitutionId").orderBy("newOrder", "codicemateriale")

dfNew = dfUnion.withColumn("numeroLinea", row_number().over(window_spec))#.drop("newOrder")
display(dfNew.filter("istitutionid = 'pagopa-psp-02'"))

# dfNew= dfNew.withColumn("pu", when(col("numeroLinea") == 2, round((col("PrezzoUnitario") / 100),2)).otherwise(""))
# dfNew = dfNew.drop("PrezzoUnitario")
# dfNew = dfNew.withColumnRenamed("pu","PrezzoUnitario").filter(col("numero").isNotNull())
#display(dfNew)
#display(dfNew)

result = {"listaFatture": []}
fatture_dict = {}

for row in dfNew.collect():
    istitutionID = row["istitutionId"]
    
    if (istitutionID) not in fatture_dict:
        fatture_dict[(istitutionID)] = {
            "numero": row["numero"],
            "dataFattura":row["dataFattura"],
            "prodotto":row["prodotto"],
            "identificativo":row["identificativo"],
            "tipologiaFattura":row["tipologiaFattura"],
            "istitutioID": istitutionID,
            "onboardingTokenID":row["onboardingTokenID"],
            "tipoDocumento":row["tipoDocumento"],
            "divisa":row["divisa"],
            "metodoPagamento":row["metodoPagamento"],
            "causale":row["causale"],
            "split": False, #row["split"],
            "sollecito":row["sollecito"],
            "datiGeneraliDocumento": [{"tipologia":row["tipologia"],"idDocumento":row["idDocumento"],\
                                     "numItem":row["numItem"], "codiceCommessaConvenzione":row["codiceCommessaConvenzione"],"CUP": row["CUP"], "CIG": row["CIG"]}],
            "posizioni": []
        }
    
    fatture_dict[(istitutionID)]["posizioni"].append({
        "numerolinea": row["numeroLinea"],
        "testo": row["testo"],
        "codiceMateriale":row["codiceMateriale"],
        "quantita": "" if row["numeroLinea"] == 1 else row["quantita"],
        "prezzoUnitario": float(row['PrezzoUnitario']) if ((row["PrezzoUnitario"] is not None) & (row["newOrder"] == 99998))  else "",
        "imponibile": "", #row["Imponibile"],
        "periodoRiferimento": "PUB" if row["PeriodoRiferimento"] != "PRI" else "PRI"
    })

result["listaFatture"] = [{"fattura": fattura} for fattura in fatture_dict.values()]
#print(result)

# Converti in stringa JSON
json_result = json.dumps(result, indent=4)

# Stampa il risultato JSON
#print(json_result)

file_path = f"abfss://pagopa@fatpdls.dfs.core.windows.net/KPMG_report/{anno_trimestre}/Json/fatturepagopa_{anno_trimestre}.json"


mssparkutils.fs.put(file_path, json_result, overwrite=True)
